=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:244-283 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When `vr_state` is `success`, the success branch of `review_sweep_verdict_wait_reason` (line 264) returns before the `rb_judge_verdict` / `rb_judge_merge_deferred` check. The judge posts head-gate success (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2798, 2919, 3493) before the merge attempt that sets `RB_MERGE_WAIT_TOKEN="blocked"` (lines 2817, 2938, 3501, 3512), so heads with a `wait=blocked` or `wait=checks_not_ready` verdict are never recognised as waiting.
  WHY: Heads whose deferred judge merge was blocked by the #9939 guard, with no ai:final-ci-merge-pending label and no auto-merge, are dispatched on every sweep tick and never reach `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert`. `test_judge_verdict_head_is_skipped_and_not_capped` uses gate PENDING with wait=blocked, a combination the judge never produces, so the test misses this. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:865-866 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The round-cap jq exemption `... and ($vw != "true" or (((.rb_judge_verdict // "") | test("^decision=(merge|merge_with_followup) ")) | not))` checks only whether a merge verdict exists on the head, not whether that verdict is still waiting. Heads that fail open (`parse`, `checks`, `base`, `base_unknown`, pr_checks_lib.sh not loaded, or a lease or merge state that has changed) are therefore exempt from SWEEP_REVIEW_MAX_ROUNDS.
  WHY: The stale ai-review/rb-judge-verdict status stays on the head, so fail-open heads are dispatched every 30-minute tick with no cap and no escalation. The issue says the opposite: "The round cap still bounds that path." tests/test_review_sweep_round_cap.py test_head_with_a_judge_merge_verdict_is_not_capped locks the current behaviour in. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4021-4025 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_pr_rb_judge_verdict_waiting` (`if [ -z "${vw_cur_ms}" ] || [ "${vw_cur_ms}" != "${PR_RB_VERDICT_MS}" ]`) detects G2's "result of a required check" only through the aggregate mergeable_state/mergeStateStatus. A required check that moves from pending to failed or missing usually leaves the state at `blocked`, so the verdict still reads as waiting.
  WHY: Stall recovery (`_stall_rb_judge_verdict_unchanged`) keeps returning rc 4, which does not increment the recovery count and never escalates, and the sweep keeps logging rb_judge_merge_deferred. The PR stays parked until someone pushes, because the final-CI repair path only covers ci/final. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:339-360 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert` POSTs the once-per-head `ai-review/merge-wait-alert` marker and increments `REVIEW_SWEEP_VERDICT_ALERTS_SENT` before it checks Telegram availability, TG_BOT_SECRET/TG_CHAT_ID, `_tg_should_send WARNING`, and delivery.
  WHY: For every outcome other than sent (`telegram_unavailable`, `telegram_unconfigured`, `below_alert_level`, `not_delivered`, and also DRY_RUN), the marker stays on the head, later ticks read `merge_wait_alerted=true`, and the G3 alert is lost for good. Each such non-alert also uses one of the 5 per-tick slots. minimax adds that this write has no kill switch or gate to disable it. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4030-4040 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The base SHA recorded in the verdict is never refreshed. After any commit to the default branch, `vw_cur_base != PR_RB_VERDICT_BASE` is true on every evaluation, so `_pr_base_freshness` (a compare at pr_checks_lib.sh:1521 plus a paginated pulls/<n>/files read at 1561) runs on every sweep tick and every stall cycle for every verdict head.
  WHY: This breaks the issue's §15 rule of "no new per-PR call inside the sweep loop or the stall loop" (about 36 or more calls per tick for 18 PRs), and `test_api_calls_per_tick_do_not_grow` never moves the base. sonnet also notes that `_pr_base_freshness` compares against the current base tip, so a PR that already overlapped reports `overlap` on the next unrelated base move. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:30776-30812 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_stall_rb_judge_verdict_unchanged` makes one unbatched `gh_retry _safe_gh_jq "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${vu_head}/status?per_page=100"` read (line 30802) for every pre-filtered judge candidate, including blocked PRs that have no verdict marker. It is called from _dispatch_rb_judge_for_pr at line 30864.
  WHY: Poller API use grows by one read per candidate per cycle. rc 4 never increments the recovery count, so the reads continue indefinitely, and the issue's §14/§15 batching constraint is not met (STALL_MANAGED_LINKED_PR_CACHE does not carry commit statuses). Severity disagreement: sonnet rated it NIT, gemini, minimax and luna rated it MAJOR; the highest is used.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:275-321 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The sweep step is claimed to define only a `gh_api_retry` fallback and not to source scripts/gh_helpers.sh, so `gh_retry` and `_safe_gh_jq` would be undefined for `_merge_lease_read`, `_pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers` (pr_checks_lib.sh:684, 698) and `_pr_base_freshness`. The calls involved are at scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:320-327.
  WHY: If the claim holds, alerts always log `blocker=-` and base-moved heads always yield `base_unknown`, so the G2 base-moved skip never engages. sonnet, luna and glm each state they verified this claim as wrong: the job checks out the repository root and sources scripts/gh_helpers.sh at lines 279-280, which defines `gh_retry` and `_safe_gh_jq`.
- scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh:320-327 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Each eligible alert performs per-PR lease and ruleset-blocker lookups instead of batching those reads across alert candidates.
  WHY: The helper's own documentation allows up to three ruleset reads plus two lease reads per alert inside the sweep loop, which goes against the issue's constraint to batch unavoidable reads.
- tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py:65-67, 354-364 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The call-count test uses a fixed verdict timestamp of `2026-11-23T09:00:00Z`, while the alert threshold defaults to six hours.
  WHY: From 15:00 UTC on that date onwards, the enabled run raises an alert and makes extra API calls, so the `len(_api_calls) <= baseline` assertion fails depending on when the test runs.
- tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py:test_api_calls_per_tick_do_not_grow | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The API-call-count test uses the same base SHA for the baseline and the verdict-wait run, so the recurring `_pr_base_freshness` reads after a base move are never counted.
  WHY: A regression that adds per-head reads after a base move would pass this test, and test_stall_rb_judge_verdict_skip.py has no per-cycle baseline comparison at all.
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:review_rb_judge_verdict_post_status | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The sweep (cap exemption, .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:866) and the poller (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:30800) trust the ai-review/rb-judge-verdict status without checking that its creator is the pipeline identity.
  WHY: Any token with statuses:write can post a spoofed `decision=merge wait=lease_wait` status that suppresses dispatches and the round cap for that head indefinitely. glm rated it NIT (hardening, requires write access); sonnet and minimax raised the same issue only as hardening suggestions.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G3, "A head that has had a verdict for longer than a configurable time without merging raises one alert through the existing stuck-merge alert path. The alert names the blocker (for example ci/final (missing) from _pr_ruleset_required_check_blockers, or the lease holder)."
  expected_change_site: The `reason=merge_lease_wait` skip path in .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml (lines 784-791), plus the rc 4 paths in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (lines 22573, 22749, 29474) and the lease-holder branch of `review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert` in scripts/review_sweep_head_gate.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The only call to review_sweep_verdict_merge_wait_alert is at review_autofix_sweep.yml:844-846, inside the `reason=verdict_waiting` branch. ai:merge-lease-wait heads `continue` earlier, at lines 784-788 (active by default because MERGE_LEASE_ENABLED and MERGE_TRAIN_ENABLED are true), so the lease-holder branch is unreachable for the #9987 deadlock heads. The stall-recovery rc 4 handlers log STALL_SKIP and raise no alert. Heads with blocked or checks_not_ready verdicts and a successful gate never alert. test_old_verdict_alerts_once_per_head covers only an auto-merge head with gate success.
- requirement: Tests, "API call counts per sweep and per poller cycle do not grow (fake-gh call log)."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_stall_rb_judge_verdict_skip.py and tests/test_review_sweep_verdict_wait.py (base-moved case)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The poller tests (lines 97-105) run single helper invocations and never compare per-cycle counts against a baseline. test_api_calls_per_tick_do_not_grow (lines 354-364) never moves the base. The commits/<head>/status read at orchestrate_poll_process.sh:30802 and the _pr_base_freshness reads at pr_checks_lib.sh:4035 are not measured.
- requirement: "Also run tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py and tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py."
  expected_change_site: PR validation results
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The PR description marks both tests, and the other acceptance tests, as "not run". The pre-push test gate is marked unverified with `container_rc_137`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

The judge posts head-gate success (scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines 2798, 2919 and 3493) before the merge attempt that sets `RB_MERGE_WAIT_TOKEN="blocked"` (lines 2817, 2938, 3501, 3512).
  WHY: Heads whose merge was blocked by the #9939 guard are dispatched on every tick, never get `reason=verdict_waiting`, and never alert.
